description: Check caller-declared rules across fields of a JSON record: end after start, conditional required, exactly one of — Evaluates up to 100 rules you declare over one JSON document and reports, per rule, pass, fail or unknown with the JSON pointer of every violating field and the actual value class (absent, null, empty string, value). Rule kinds: compare (>, >=, <, <=, ==, != on numbers, exact decimals, RFC 3339 dates or date-times, strings), required-if, forbidden-if, exactly-one, at-most-one, at-least-one, all-or

data.description: The JSON document the rules apply to.

onMissing.description: Missing or null compare operand: unknown (default), fail or skip.

left.description: JSON pointer; * matches every array element.

presence.description: What counts as present: defined (key exists), non-null (default), non-empty.

right.description: JSON pointer compared with left (use value for a constant).

value.description: Constant to compare with, or the expected total.
Operand for equals, not-equals, in, not-in.

name: cross-field-rules
